description: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved venetoclax for reimbursement as a monotherapy treatment option for the treatment of patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) in the absence of 17p deletion or TP53 mutation in adult patients who have failed both chemoimmunotherapy and a B-cell receptor pathway inhibitor.
